evidence_quotes.O: This camera will allow you to express your creativity in ways that you won't outgrow quickly.
evidence_quotes.C: I have taken a couple of hundred shots with this lens at all focal lengths and through the full aperture range, and I have found no obvious flaws.
evidence_quotes.E: Sitting indoors at my kitchen table and typing this review, my 60CX is tracking 8 satellites
evidence_quotes.A: unfortunately, this is not an internal-focus lens (my own fault for misunderstanding the specs)
evidence_quotes.N: This will be a minor inconvenience when I use a polarising filter.
